Unified MedNova Entry for Propensity Score Matching

med_psm.Rd

Unified MedNova Entry for Propensity Score Matching

Usage

med_psm(
  data,
  treat_col,
  covariates,
  baseline = FALSE,
  return_baseline = baseline,
  return_love_plot = FALSE,
  love_data = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing treatment and covariates.

treat_col

Column name for treatment/exposure variable.

covariates

Character vector of covariate column names.

baseline

Deprecated compatibility alias for return_baseline.

return_baseline

Logical; whether to also compute baseline tables.

return_love_plot

Logical; whether to also generate a love plot.

love_data

Optional data frame already prepared for plot_love(). If omitted, med_psm() will derive love plot data from the matching summary.

...

Additional arguments passed to Epi_PSM_match().

Value

A structured list containing matched_object, matchit_model, matched_data, optional baseline_tables, balance_table, love_plot_data, and optional love_plot.
